import importlib.util

worst = (0., None)

                raw[spike] += emi

                error = float(np.max(np.abs(found-expected)))
                label = (case, bank, float(x[spike]), emi)
                failures += error > 1e-10
                if error > worst[0]:
                    worst = (error, label)
